title: GradLIME: A CNN Local Interpretation Model Based on Feature Gradient Activation (Code)
description: Official implementation of GradLIME, a CNN local interpretation model based on feature gradient activation. Includes the core method, ablation study scripts (A1c_CAM_mode to A9_RUNTIME) and evaluation utilities. Companion code for the Research Square preprint (DOI: 10.21203/rs.3.rs-7004733/v1), currently under review at Scientific Reports.
